title: Glowing map tile with route dive
summary: A rim-lit map tile grows out of dark space, a route draws across it, the camera dives to a nav arrow and follows it past three bold street labels, then pulls back to the whole tile. One continuous shot, no copy.
use_when: A navigation, delivery, travel or location product with a route as its core idea
A short teaser where one continuous camera move replaces cuts and copy
Dark premium brands that want a glow object instead of a screenshot
Opening a longer film with the product map before feature beats

look.type_style: bold rounded grotesk, title case, normal tracking, white; tiny on the full tile (~1.5 % H), ~8 % H in the close-ups, two-line street labels

sfx.event: tile lights on and grows out of the dark
camera dives from the full tile into the arrow close-up
each street label lands next to the arrow
pull-out back to the full tile

structure.shot: black space, a thin blue planet rim curves across the lower left; a small rim-lit rounded square appears at centre
structure.motion: square lights on: rim and halo rise from 0, easings.outQuint ~6 fr (±0.25 s); planet rim already present

structure.shot: square grows into a beveled dark map tile with blocks and five tiny labels; blue glow floods; a cyan route draws
structure.camera: frame-in-frame scale 0.26 -> 1.00 (tile width 9 % -> 34 % W, 0.20 -> 0.43 s), then tile settles from upper third to centre 0.77 -> 1.00
structure.motion: tile scale springs.heavy ~9 fr (overshoot not measurable); streets fade in by 0.50; route draws from the bottom-left street up, right, then up to the top edge 1.00 -> 2.00, easings.linear ~30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: dive into the tile: route close-up, white nav arrow in a two-ring grey halo puck, tile bevel at frame left
structure.camera: zoom-tier full -> detail, ~1.0 -> ~6x over 2.33 -> 2.77 (~13 fr), springs.cameraIn; then cursor-follow locked on the arrow, map scrolls down (motion.json pan 252 px/s at 3-4 s)
structure.motion: arrow travels up the route at constant speed, easings.linear; halo rings fixed around it

structure.shot: arrow reaches the first turn; a two-line bold street label (3 words) sits over the puck; route turns right
structure.camera: cursor-follow: arrow held at centre, map pans under it; slight roll as the heading turns (motion.json rot 1.5 deg/s at 7 s)
structure.motion: label scales up with the zoom, no separate entrance; arrow heading rotates ~90 deg toward the new street 4.27 -> 4.77, springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: second street: label of 2 words over the puck, the route bends from horizontal up to a diagonal
structure.camera: cursor-follow: arrow centred, map slides left then holds 5.27 -> 6.50
structure.motion: arrow heading follows the path tangent, springs.ui; label holds at full opacity

structure.shot: third street: label of 2 words; the tile edge and its light rim come into view at frame right
structure.camera: cursor-follow pans up-right along the diagonal 6.60 -> 7.07 (motion.json 26 px/s), slight push-in on the arrow 7.00 -> 7.77
structure.motion: previous label scrolls out with the map, new label carried in; easings.inOutSine ~14 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: pull back to the full glowing tile with the finished route; planet rim arcs top right; music ends 8.30
structure.camera: pull-out detail -> full 7.77 -> 8.27 (~14 fr), springs.cameraOut; tile drifts from upper third to centre 8.77 -> 9.00, then holds
structure.motion: nothing new enters; the hold mirrors the 1.00 -> 2.27 framing

params.brand: any dark brand.json: bg near black, accent drives the route colour and the background glow
params.content.streets: 3 street or place labels shown in the close-ups, 2-3 words each
params.content.mapLabels: up to 5 tiny labels on the full tile
params.content.route: polyline in tile coordinates the route draws along, with 2 turns
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: One continuous shot: cuts.json has 0 hard cuts; its 4 soft transitions (0.23, 2.33, 6.60, 7.77) are camera moves and are used as row boundaries with transition continuous. cut_on_beat 0/4. Music silent from 8.30 to the end. Route colour is a saturated cyan not caught by palettegen (accent in brand). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): route-draw, nav-puck, bevel-tile. Resolution 0.25 s from sheets; no 30 fps strips taken.
